stem: Which statement is best supported by the information in the box plots?

options.label: A
options.text: The range of the data for men 20–40 years old is less than the range of the data for men 50–70 years old.

options.label: B
options.text: The median of the data for men 20–40 years old is less than the median of the data for men 50–70 years old.

options.label: C
options.text: The minimum target heart rate for men 20–40 years old is less than the minimum target heart rate for men 50–70 years old.

options.label: D
options.text: The interquartile range of the data for men 20–40 years old is greater than the interquartile range of the data for men 50–70 years old.

visual_elements: Box plots titled Target Heart Rates of Men comparing 20–40 years old and 50–70 years old with beats per minute scale from 70 to 170.
